# Rejected Field Archive proof: 8769486

The maintainer superseded this candidate because it omitted the Axion delta
from the product crown and rendered the approved concept's outer housing and
index hardware too flat. The next candidate adds the supplied Axion identity
mark and restores restrained leather and dimensional-brass material depth to
noninteractive chrome.

These files are retained only as historical evidence. They are not an
acceptance baseline and must not be reused as current goldens.
